name: half_hitch_spiral
title: Half hitch spiral
about: The same half hitch tied again and again round a filler cord, always the same way: the knots turn round the filler as they go down and make a spiral. Shown loose and flat, three hitches.

steps.caption: Hang the filler cord straight down.
Bring the working cord down beside the filler, across in front of it, round, and back behind it.
Carry it on to the left, over its own standing part: one half hitch.
Tie a second half hitch below the first, exactly the same way: across in front of the filler, back behind it, and over its own standing part.
And a third, the same way again. Pulled tight, the hitches turn round the filler and make a spiral.
